versions.content: On reception of the UDS Service ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22) with DID in the range 0xF200 to 0xF3FF, if verification has been successfully done (see [SWS_Dcm_00651]) and the dynamic DID has been defined with a DID source (see [SWS_Dcm_00646]), the Dcm module shall do the session, security and mode dependencies checks for all source DIDs in case the configuration parameter DcmD- spDDDIDcheckPerSourceDID is set to TRUE.
